mission.vision_desc: Build a thriving tech community where students grow through hands-on learning, develop innovative projects, and empower each other to succeed.

mission.values_desc: Just Code, Just Connect, Just KL, Collaboration, Innovation, Excellence, Knowledge Sharing, and an open, international tech community.

smartmensa.subtitle: University dining management application
smartmensa.desc: SmartMensa is a web application that lets students browse menus, reserve meals and collect them using a QR code. It also helps administrators manage reservations, users and statistics, while contributing to reducing food waste.

community.testimonials_subtitle: Real voices from the JUSTCODE-KL community. Drag the dial, swipe, or use the arrows.

1.quote: JUSTCODE-KL helped me move from theory to practice. The workshops are pure gold — I built my first real project in three weeks and finally understood what I was learning in class.

2.quote: Thanks to the career program, I landed my dream internship at SAP. The mock interviews were brutally honest, and that is exactly what I needed.

3.quote: As a beginner I felt welcome right away. The community is incredibly supportive, and within my first month I had joined a project team.

4.quote: The hackathons showed me what I am really capable of. 24 hours, a team of strangers, and we won second place. That weekend taught me more than a full semester.

5.quote: My GitHub portfolio looks impressive thanks to the project workshops. I went from zero public repos to seven shipped projects in one semester.
